meta.title: Crypto Compliance Investigations | Lenix Protocol
meta.description: AML and compliance investigation workflows for tracing crypto flows, documenting findings, and supporting SAR and escalation processes — with clear scope on what on-chain review can show.

Hero.subtitle: Trace transactions across supported networks, review wallet exposure, and export structured analysis for compliance escalations — without overstating what public ledger data alone can prove.

Overview.title: Built for compliance and investigation teams
Overview.description: Lenix supports AML reviews, enhanced due diligence, and internal investigations with trace workflows, risk context, and report outputs your team can attach to case files — not vanity dashboards with unverifiable metrics.

tracing.label: Cross-network tracing
tracing.title: Follow flows across chains and assets
tracing.body: Map fund movement from a known wallet or transaction through bridges, swaps, and exchange deposits where visible on-chain. Outputs include timelines and hop-by-hop notes suitable for SAR preparation or internal escalation.

workflow.label: Investigation workflow
workflow.title: From alert to documented review
workflow.body: Start from a flagged address or transaction hash and build a case view linking related wallets, entities, and behaviors. Findings can be shared internally with audit-friendly notes on methodology and limits.

diligence.label: Due diligence
diligence.title: Review addresses before you move funds
diligence.body: Screen counterparty wallets and historical flows for exposure to known risky categories — scams, sanctions-related touchpoints, and high-risk services — scoped to your policy rules, not a generic score alone.

monitoring.label: Ongoing monitoring
monitoring.title: Watchlists and activity alerts
monitoring.body: Configure address lists and receive notifications when new activity matches your criteria. Monitoring supports recurring compliance reviews — alert volume and coverage depend on engagement terms and supported networks.

Cta.title: Need compliance investigation support?
Cta.description: Describe your team, regulatory context, and what you need from tracing or screening. We outline realistic scope before engagement.
